name: ZCA_OBJECTS
description: ZCA_OBJECTS : This  table would be used for registration of an import object

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the ZCA_OBJECTS table

columns.name: SUPPORT_OPTIMIZED_IMPORT
columns.description: This column specifies whether the object supports optimized import or not

columns.name: OBJECT_VO
columns.description: VO used to define the base REST Object

columns.name: PRIMARY_VO
columns.description: If OBJECT_VO refers to a Secondary VO, then this column would have the corresponding Primary VO name

columns.name: PRIMARY_ENTITY_DEFINITION
columns.description: Primary Entity Object Definition for the corresponding Viewobject

columns.name: LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE
columns.description: 'Language Independent Code' of the corresponding object in bulk import, if it exists

columns.name: OBJECT_PARENT_LIC
columns.description: Comma separated list of 'LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE' values used to identify potential parent of object of a current object. Will be used for hierarchical display purpose

columns.name: CUSTOM_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether it is a custom object

columns.name: MDS_LAST_UPDATE_TIME
columns.description: A TIMESTAMP to denote the time when MDS definition was read for this object to update its metadata in this table

columns.name: UCM_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: UCM_ACCOUNT_NUMBER stores the UCM folder name where files are uploaded.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: This will be used for defining security predicates. The possible values are StandardObject, StandardChild, CustomChildOfStandard, CustomObject, CustomChildOfCustom, IntersectionObject

columns.name: PRIMARY_VO_COUNT
columns.description: Column saves an integer number which will indicate the number of primary vo a secondary object is based on

columns.name: LABEL_RESID
columns.description: It specifies the Label ResId for the object. It will be used to determine the display name for the object.

columns.name: OBJECT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: It specifies the description for the object.

columns.name: OBJECT_QUERY
columns.description: It specifies the query to fetch the details related to object.

columns.name: OBJECT_QUERY_ELEVATED
columns.description: It specifies the elevated query of the object

columns.name: PLURAL_LABEL_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: It specifies the plural label resource identifier of an object. It is used to determine the plural display label of the object

columns.name: REST_RESOURCE_CODE
columns.description: It Specifies  the REST REsource code of the object

columns.name: REST_RESOURCE_ROW_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: It Specifies the REST Resource RowIdentifier of the object

columns.name: REST_ATTACHMENT_RESOURCE_URL
columns.description: It Specifies the REST  Attachment Resource URL of the object

columns.name: EXTENSIBLE_VIEW_DEFINITION
columns.description: It Specifies the Extensible VO for the object. If VO is not extensible it stores null
